Physics 2014-II.subject: Physics
Physics 2014-II.question: Inactive Nitrogen and Argon gases are usually used in electric bulbs in order to
options: increase the intensity of light emitted
increase the life of the filament
make the production of bulb economical
Physics 2014-II.answer: increase the life of the filament
Physics 2014-II.explanation: (b)  The inert gas within the bulb prevents the filament from evaporating.Thus it increases the life of the filament.

Physics 2014-II.question: In the phenomenon of dispersion of light, the light wave of shortest wavelength is
options: slowed down and refracted the most
slowed down and refracted the least
Physics 2014-II.answer: slowed down and refracted the most
Physics 2014-II.explanation: (b)  Short wavelength is slowed down and refracted the most

Physics 2014-II.question: The distribution of electrons into different orbits of an atom, as suggested by Bohr; is
options: 2 electrons in the K-orbit, 6 electrons in the L-orbit, 18 electrons in the M-orbit
2 electrons in the K-orbit, 8 electrons in the L-orbit, 32 electrons in the M-orbit
2 electrons in the K-orbit, 8 electrons in the L-orbit, 18 electrons in the M-orbit
2 electrons in the K-orbit, 8 electrons in the L-orbit, 16 electrons in the M-orbit
Physics 2014-II.answer: 2 electrons in the K-orbit, 8 electrons in the L-orbit, 18 electrons in the M-orbit
Physics 2014-II.explanation: (c)  Maximum n of electrons in K,L, M and N is 2, 8, 18 and 32 respectively.

Physics 2014-II.question: Carbon or Graphite rods are used in atomic reactors as moderators for sustained nuclear chain reaction through nuclear fission process. In this process
Physics 2014-II.explanation: (c)  Moderators like carbon and Graphite are used for slowing down the neutrons in a nuclear reactor. Neutrons from fission have very high speeds and must be slowed greatly by "moderation" to maintain the chain reaction.
